$schema_note: SCOPE (final, per direction 2026-08-22): FIFTEEN markets total - the DMV core (one market, four jurisdiction entries) + Baltimore, Richmond, Hampton Roads, Philadelphia (incl. Wilmington), Newark/Jersey City + nine majors (NYC, Boston, Chicago, LA, SF, Seattle, Miami, Atlanta, Dallas). Research and website coverage stop at this list; nothing else is screened or claimed.

metros.name: Washington DC

fmr_fy2026.note: Washington-Arlington-Alexandria DC-VA-MD HMFA. Primary-confirmed via DCHA Resolution 25-31 (read 2026-08-24): the Board's FY2026 payment standards are exactly 187% of FMR, and every bedroom reverses onto these values — $4,200/1.87 = $2,246 (2BR), $3,652/1.87 = $1,953, $3,768/1.87 = $2,015, $5,301/1.87 = $2,835. Mandatory SAFMR zone (ZIP-level rents govern vouchers).

market_notes.value: Pre-1976 rowhouse-flat stock rent-stabilized unless natural-person exemption applies; post-1975 buildings exempt; TOPA largely gone for 2-4s under Law 26-80.

gaps: Class 1 tax-rate row not yet a benchmark

metros.name: Prince George's County MD

fmr_fy2026.note: Part of the Washington-Arlington-Alexandria DC-VA-MD HUD Metro FMR Area — the metro-wide FY2026 2BR ($2,246, see the DC entry) applies here. ZIP-level SAFMRs govern vouchers (FY2026 per-ZIP values still pending huduser pull). FY2026 boundary change: Calvert County MD was removed from the DC HMFA (FR 2025-16060).

market_notes.value: Inside-Beltway towns (Mount Rainier, Hyattsville, Brentwood, Capitol Heights) hold the county's 2-4 unit stock; PRSA caps increases at lesser of 6% or CPI-U+3% with the natural-person ≤5-unit exemption (no domicile condition per county FAQ).

gaps: county tax-rate + municipal add-on benchmark rows

fmr_fy2026.note: Part of the Washington-Arlington-Alexandria DC-VA-MD HUD Metro FMR Area — the metro-wide FY2026 2BR ($2,246, see the DC entry) applies here; ZIP-level SAFMRs govern vouchers (per-ZIP values pending).

market_notes.value: County rent stabilization (CPI+3% capped 6%) with building-age and small-owner exemptions; Takoma Park layers its OWN stricter regime (all 2+ unit rentals, no small-owner exemption, FY2027 allowance 3.0%).

metros.name: Northern Virginia

fmr_fy2026.note: Part of the Washington-Arlington-Alexandria DC-VA-MD HUD Metro FMR Area — the metro-wide FY2026 2BR ($2,246, see the DC entry) applies here. SAFMR zone (Prince William confirmed a SAFMR jurisdiction, 3-0); per-ZIP values pending.

market_notes.value: No rent control anywhere in Virginia (Dillon-Rule absence of grant; enabling bills keep failing). Near-zero on-market 2-4 unit inventory — Prince William read '0 Homes' for duplex/triplex in July 2026; off-market sourcing (tax-delinquency pipeline) is the entry. Fairfax/Arlington comps staged in discovery mode.

gaps: PW County assessment URL pattern documented in county_data_sources.json

metros.name: Baltimore MD

fmr_fy2026.note: Baltimore-Columbia-Towson MSA; range brackets are the 90/110% payment-standard structure.

market_notes.value: Q1 2026 metro multifamily volume +53.1% YoY to $367M — strongest quarter since 2022. No rent cap in the city, but license-before-rent (unlicensed = no right to collect) and the code-violation rent freeze invert the value-add sequence: license, cure, then reposition.

gaps: City 2-4 unit median (metro Redfin series not broken out for Baltimore in the May pull)

fmr_fy2026.note: Richmond, VA HUD Metro FMR Area, per GeraRent's HUD-FY2026 area pages (search-surfaced; exact page URL not captured — same republisher matched HUD exactly for Dallas). A -3.3% year from FY2025's $1,711 (rentdata.org), within HUD's 10% annual decrease bound. Beware conflation: 'Richmond County VA' (Northern Neck, ~$1,157) is a different area.

market_notes.value: Institutional multifamily YTD median $129,500/unit (Q1 2026, skewed by one high-vacancy trade; $180,700/unit excluding it) amid elevated supply with steady vacancy. No rent control (VA). City open-data comp feed queued in county_data_sources.json.

metros.name: Norfolk / Hampton Roads VA

fmr_fy2026.note: Virginia Beach-Norfolk-Newport News VA-NC HMFA (one HMFA across Hampton Roads; city pages mirror it). $1,713 per PlainRent's FY2026 Newport News page — trajectory-consistent with FY2025 $1,696 (USHousingData, Norfolk) and FY2024 $1,493 (RentData).

market_notes.value: No rent control (VA). Military-demand rental base; screened for stock/pricing in a future pass — currently the thinnest data of the eight metros.

gaps: city assessor feeds (Norfolk/VB open-data portals exist — unassessed)

market_notes.value: The deepest accessible 2-4 unit market on the coast: $363,500 May 2026 median (+6.9% YoY), 366 active listings (Redfin), ~1,075 multi-family listings on Homes.com (July 2026). No rent control (PA); § 9-811 eviction diversion adds a verified 30-day pre-filing step. Auto-comps live via OPA. Wilmington DE sits inside the Philadelphia orbit: no rent control at any level in Delaware (New Castle comps staged in discovery).

metros.name: Newark / Jersey City

fmr_fy2026.note: Newark NJ HMFA row (Essex-side of this market), from HUD's FY2026 FMR documentation system as republished by NJ Treasury (primary, full table read 2026-08-24). Jersey City NJ HMFA (Hudson County) prices separately: 2BR $2,763 (same document). The same table re-confirms Philadelphia-Camden-Wilmington 2BR $1,810.

market_notes.value: The two big screened NJ rent-control cities split exactly on the small-building question: Jersey City exempts EVERY 1-4 unit property regardless of occupancy (5+ built pre-1987 is controlled); Newark exempts 1-4 family ONLY when owner-occupied. Statewide, ~100 other NJ ordinances remain unscreened - check before offer. NJ MOD-IV property rolls are statewide (provider wired for parcels).

gaps: per-ordinance screen for other NJ municipalities

market_notes.value: The small-building path through NYC: rent stabilization requires 6+ units built pre-1974, so 2-4 unit product trades UNregulated on rent - but Good Cause Eviction (2024) applies citywide unless the owner holds <=10 units statewide or owner-occupies a <=10-unit building. Deed history via ACRIS; DOF Rolling Sales lacks coordinates (BBL join to PLUTO documented in ingestion_sources.md).

metros.name: Chicago

fmr_fy2026.note: Chicago-Joliet-Naperville IL HUD Metro FMR Area; figure surfaced via search excerpts of HUD's FY2026 FMR documentation system (direct huduser fetch blocked from this environment — the linked query system is the primary).

market_notes.value: No rent control anywhere in Illinois (Preemption Act 1997, repeal attempts keep failing). Chicago's RLTO is the real compliance load - and owner-occupied buildings of <=6 units are exempt from most of it, which fits a house-hacked 2-4 unit purchase exactly. Cook County parcel + sales data on Socrata (documented).

gaps: Cook County Socrata dataset ids (resolve at wiring)

fmr_fy2026.note: Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale CA HMFA — REVISED FY2026 FMRs (Federal Register Vol. 91 No. 76, Doc 2026-07741, Apr 21 2026), effective 2026-05-21; supersedes the Oct 2025 schedule for this area (primary, read 2026-08-24).

market_notes.value: Two regimes stack: the city RSO (2+ units built on/before Oct 1, 1978 - caps, just-cause, relocation fees) and AB 1482 statewide for everything the RSO misses (5%+CPI max 10%, 15-year new-construction exemption, owner-occupied duplex exemption). A pre-1979 fourplex here is regulated stock - underwrite the cap, not pro-forma rents. County assessor roll ~2.4M parcels (plan-size driver).

fmr_fy2026.note: San Francisco HMFA. FY26 HUD FMR row from the SF Housing Authority's 2026 Payment Standards sheet (revised 2025-10-23; primary, read 2026-08-24) — SFHA payment standard is 110% of FMR ($3,964 for a 2BR). Aggregator figures ($2,850 / $3,174) were rejected as conflations; the 2-source bar caught them.

market_notes.value: Two regimes stack: the SF Rent Ordinance (essentially all residential built before June 13, 1979 - Rent Board caps + just-cause; post-1979 stock exempt from the caps but, since 2024, covered by just-cause anyway) and AB 1482 statewide for the rest. Pre-1979 SF multifamily is regulated stock - underwrite the allowed increase, not pro-forma rents. Secured assessor roll on data.sfgov.org (Socrata).

fmr_fy2026.note: FY2026 metro 2BR still unverified — and the widely-quoted $2,501 turned out to be Seattle's average market rent, not the FMR (conflation caught 2026-08-24; never encoded). FY2025 2BR was $2,671 for the Seattle-Bellevue HMFA (King/Snohomish, USHousingData). Mandatory SAFMR area — ZIP bands roughly $1,700-$3,000. huduser/KCHA primary pull queued; never estimated.

market_notes.value: Washington's 2025 HB 1217 now caps increases statewide (lesser of 7%+CPI or 10%; 9.683% for 2026) with a 12-year new-construction exemption - Seattle adds landlord regulations (JumpStart-era rules) but no separate city rent cap. King County publishes a dedicated real-property SALES file: the easiest comps win in the West.

metros.name: Dallas-Fort Worth

fmr_fy2026.note: Dallas, TX HUD Metro FMR Area (two independent republishers agree; HUD-FY2026-attributed). Fort Worth-Arlington-Grapevine TX HMFA prices separately and is not yet on file. ZIP-level SAFMRs span roughly $1,520-$2,900 across the metroplex.
